newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar, bonds edge up on data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar, bonds edge up on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds edged higher after the Bureau Statistics released first quarter business inventories and April balance of goods and services.
Stocks fell 2.1 percent compared with a 1.2 percent rise in the December quarter and a forecast 0.5 percent rise.
The trade balance was a A$302 million surplus after a A$103 million deficit in March and an expected A$100 million surplus.
The dollar was at US$0.7651/53 compared with US$0.7647/52 just before the data, while June 10-year bonds touched a day's high of 92.405 against a pre-data 92.385.
